name.ja: Figure-rise Standard デュークモン

description.ja: 『デジモンテイマーズ』より聖騎士型デジモン「デュークモン」をアニメ設定に準拠したデザインとプロポーションで立体化！
description.en: From "Digimon Tamers ", the Holy Knight Digimon " Dukemon" has been made into a three-dimensional figure with a design and proportions that conform to the anime settings!

description.ja: ■こだわりのパーツ分割で、組み立てるだけで満足のいく仕上がり。
description.en: • Carefully divided parts allow for a satisfying finish just by assembling.

description.ja: ■関節パーツが広範囲に可動し、劇中さながらのアクションポーズが再現可能。
description.en: • Joint parts can move over a wide range, allowing you to recreate action poses just like in the movie.

description.ja: ■武装には銀色の成形色を使用し、劇中同様の質感を表現。
description.en: • The armament uses silver molding color to express the same texture as in the play.

description.ja: ■細部にまでこだわり、「聖盾イージス」に刻まれたデジ文字も再現。
description.en: • With attention to detail, the digital characters engraved on the "Holy Shield Aegis" are also reproduced.

description.ja: ■ハンドパーツの他に「聖盾イージス」を保持するための台座も付属。
description.en: • In addition to the hand parts, a pedestal to hold the "Holy Shield Aegis" is also included.

description.ja: ■デュークモンのマントには布素材を使用。
